name: flow-factory
description: FLOW FACTORY — puzzle de esteiras e roteamento (HTML5 + Canvas + JS puro), empacotado para Android com Capacitor.

scripts.sync: npm run vendor && npm run levels:check && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.android:apk-release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
